Capture one actual complete inference forward through removable owned model hooks, including input tensor bytes, kwargs, attention metadata, forward context and KV-state reset protocol. minimal_next_design.design: First specify and implement a host-owned exclusive scheduler replay boundary for the dedicated standard-started Worker. minimal_next_design.blocking_design_decision: No supported reentrant host scheduler executor is currently present. If the deployed engine cannot execute this contract synchronously, a reviewed phase-continuation orchestration change is required before claiming completion; merely invoking external generate from the existing blocking RPC will not fix it.
minimal_next_design.phase_refactor_constraints: Any later continuation design must preserve one attempt across all phases, unforgeable owner/generation, real request binding, fail-closed cancellation, controlled native scope, complete OFF recovery and no new Registry/CLI or overwritten Worker core method. It is not implemented or approved by this document alone.
